limits: Ranges are editorial planning estimates for new meaning, not drafted or measured native units. Overlaps with existing 20204–20209/20505–20507 must be deducted rather than counted twice.
Do not add both Australian cases plus UK demo plus two reviews merely to reach a duration target.

The original demo already supplies nearly all current remove/sew/heat-join/trim/wipe/lace/pack actions. Hand movement subdivision, two foot-shaped pieces on bench, or repeating each seam state earns no defensible new-information quota.
No proof of heel-lining cutting/sanding/gluing in the original 38.144-second demo; only separate written Orson case supports cutting/gluing thin suede.
No exact needle setting, seam allowance, thread gauge, trim depth, pressure, cure/cool time, adhesive formula or measured durability found for the UK demonstration.
A FAQ example can improve the causal service-choice question but cannot supply a thousand units of physical repair activity.
capacity_assessment.recommendation: Do not commission an R11 expansion of 1000–1400 units as though evidence already supports it. Adopt the narrow diagnostic distinction if useful, then either obtain a longer documented same-pair primary repair record or make an explicit scope/target decision. Actual paid TTS remains gated and is not a substitute for source capacity.
